defects.title: The documented constraint index cannot be used as constraintID
defects.trigger: model = createModel({'R1','R2','EX_A','EX_C'}, {'R1','R2','EX_A','EX_C'}, {'A -> B','B <=> C','A <=> ','C -> '}); model = addCOBRAConstraints(model, {'R1','R2'}, 5, 'c', [1 1], 'dsense', 'L'); changeCOBRAConstraints(model, 1, 'd', 7)
defects.observed: error "The value of 'constraintID' is invalid. It must satisfy the function: @(x)ischar(x)&&any(ismember(model.ctrs,x))." (the validator accepts only a char ID, so the numeric path after line 75 is never used)
defects.expected: model.d(1) = 7 (INPUTS: "constraintID: The ID of the constraint (or the index in the ctrs field)")

notes: Multi-function legacy test testConstraints.m also calls it (not renamed). Repro (MATLAB): model = createModel({'R1','R2','EX_A','EX_C'}, {'R1','R2','EX_A','EX_C'}, {'A -> B','B <=> C','A <=> ','C -> '}); model = addCOBRAConstraints(model, {'R1','R2'}, 5, 'c', [1 1], 'dsense', 'L'); changeCOBRAConstraints(model, 1, 'd', 7) -> invalid constraintID. Also seen (not recorded as a defect): a column-vector c with idList is rejected by the size(c,2) check at line 88. No src caller.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: the documented index form of the constraint ID errors)

defects.title: Two models with different numbers of reactions stop with an error
defects.trigger: m1 = createModel({'R1','R2','EX_A','EX_C'}, {'R1','R2','EX_A','EX_C'}, {'A -> B','B <=> C','A <=> ','C -> '}); m2 = createModel({'R1','R2','EX_A'}, {'R1','R2','EX_A'}, {'A -> B','B <=> C','A <=> '}); [isSame, nDiff] = isSameCobraModel(m1, m2)
defects.observed: error "Arrays have incompatible sizes for this operation." (value1 == value2 on numeric fields of different sizes; strcmp on cell fields of different sizes fails in the same way)
defects.expected: isSame = false with the differing fields counted ("Checks if two COBRA models are the same")

defects.title: Logical fields are never compared
defects.trigger: m1 as above; a = m1; a.myFlag = true(4,1); b = m1; b.myFlag = false(4,1); isSameCobraModel(a, b)
defects.observed: isSame = true (a logical value is neither numeric, cellstr nor char, so nDiff stays 0)
defects.expected: false: the common field myFlag differs in 4 positions (OUTPUTS: "True if all common fields are identical")

defects.title: Text fields are compared with every non-word character removed, not only white space
defects.observed: isSame = true ('R-1' and 'R1' are equal after regexprep(value, '[^\w'']', ''))
defects.expected: false: rxnNames{1} differs (code comment: "replace all whitespaces")

defects.title: The message for differing nested subSystems names prints 0 positions
defects.trigger: a = m1; a.subSystems = {{'A'};{'B'};{'A'};{'A'}}; b = m1; b.subSystems = {{'A'};{'A'};{'A'};{'A'}}; isSameCobraModel(a, b, 1)
defects.observed: prints "Field subSystems differs in 0 positions between the models" (nDiff(i) is printed before it is assigned)
defects.expected: the number of differing subSystem names

notes: Many existing tests use it as an assertion helper (testConstraintModifciation, testWriteSBML, testLiftModel, ...); they compare models of equal size, so they do not reach the size defect but rely on the comparison whose logical-field and punctuation gaps are recorded. Repro: see TRIGGER fields (m1/m2 from createModel). No src caller. Lead: decide whether tests that assert with isSameCobraModel are affected by the quarantine (they reach the wrong-result forms only if they compare logical fields or punctuation-only differences).
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproductions: different reaction counts error; logical fields never compared; punctuation stripped so 'R-1' equals 'R1')

defects.title: The rules are not reduced to the minimal DNF form: absorbed clauses are kept
defects.trigger: model = createModel({'R1','R2','EX_A','EX_C'}, {'R1','R2','EX_A','EX_C'}, {'A -> B','B <=> C','A <=> ','C -> '}); model.genes = {'g1';'g2'}; model.rules = {'x(1) | (x(1) & x(2))'; ''; ''; ''}; out = NormaliseGPRs(model)
defects.observed: out.rules{1} = '(x(1) | x(1) & x(2))' and out.grRules{1} = '(g1 or g1 and g2)' (only identical clauses are removed by removeDNFduplicates)
defects.expected: x(1) (g1): x1 or (x1 and x2) = x1 by absorption (header: "reduce them to the minimal DNF Form"; OUTPUTS: "all GPRS in minimal DNF form")

notes: Does NOT reach the quarantined Node/AndNode/OrNode forms: it calls only FormulaParser.parseFormula, reduce, convertToDNF, OrNode.removeDNFduplicates and toString (no removeDuplicateLiterals, isequal or deleteLiteral). The legacy test testGPRLogic.m pins the non-minimal output (it expects clause {1,2,4,5} next to {1,4,5}), so the lead must decide whether 'minimal DNF' in the header is a defect or loose wording; if loose, the function can be tested normally. geneRegExp is documented but unused. Prints one fprintf per non-empty rule (not gated). Repro: see TRIGGER.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: 'x(1) | (x(1) & x(2))' is not reduced to the minimal DNF the help promises)

defects.title: The collapsed model does not match the input model as documented: its reactions are sorted and its objective is zero
defects.trigger: [model, fullmodel] = expa(m) for any m whose reactions are not already internal-first in name order, or whose c is not zero
defects.observed: model.rxns = {'R1';'R2';'EX_A';'EX_B';'EX_C'} for the input order {'R1';'R2';'EX_A';'EX_C';'EX_B'}; model.c all zero; all fields mutually consistent
defects.expected: OUTPUTS: 'The model output matches the original model input'

notes: The coverage tool (CodeCoveragePlugin/Cobertura) reports 0 executable lines for expa.m (test passed); lines/missed here come from MATLAB's profiler (callstats file_lines = 361 lines; profile ExecutedLines on a run of the test), as the header says. Lead: confirm this substitute or check why Cobertura lists no line for this file. Exchange reactions are assumed to be in the COBRA convention (coefficient -1): the merge of two-way exchanges (lines 449-455) adds TE*T1(x(j),i), which balances only for a -1 coefficient; not recorded as a defect (the documented bounds convention implies -1). Pathway expectations are hand-derived extreme rays, checked exactly (integer entries).

defects.observed: error "Index exceeds array bounds." in contructItems line 463 (model.rxnGeneMat is 2 x 0); with rmfield(model, 'rxnGeneMat') the error is "Cell elements must be character vectors." at line 465 (strrep on the nested cell model.subSystems), after the warnings "Inputs must be character vectors, cell arrays of character vectors, or string arrays." from strrep on the numeric fields
defects.expected: the output file with a notes block holding the fields of reaction R1 (header: "Retrieves omics data from a COBRA model structure and add them to a CellDesginer XML file")

notes: Also seen: nargin < 4 uses undefined recon2 (line 61); numeric/matrix fields are indexed linearly (model.rxnGeneMat(num)). showprogress creates the globals WAITBAR_TYPE/WAITBAR_HANDLE (a test would need to clean them). defects.observed: the block after species A is <rdf:Description rdf:about="#A"> with <rdf:li rdf:resource="urn:miriam:chebi:16027"/>, the ChEBI ID of B (constructItems is called with infix(in), where in is the last value of the earlier loop, not the matched entry)
